title.en: Switch Channels on a Color Image

brief.zh: 在同一个像素上切换 RGB、单色通道和灰度，观察整张图怎样变化。
brief.en: Keep one pixel selected while switching between RGB, single channels, and grayscale. Watch the whole image change.

concept.zh: 每个通道保留一种颜色的强度。灰度融合了三种通道的读数。
concept.en: Each channel keeps the intensity of one color. Grayscale combines values from all three channels.

hints.zh: 在 (0, 0) 的红色格子上比较红通道和蓝通道，它们的读数差很多。
hints.en: Compare the red and blue channels at the red tile (0, 0). Their readings are far apart.

prompt.zh: 把目标固定在 (0, 0)，分别显示红、绿、蓝通道，再看灰度的读数。
prompt.en: Keep (0, 0) selected, view the red, green, and blue channels, then check the grayscale reading.
